replay_hand_state.ron_tile: hasRonWinningTile records whether the replay state has appended the winning tile; never infer this from hand length or tile identity
replay_hand_state.changsha_multiple_ron: replace the previously appended winning tile when the same player wins on another kong replacement tile
replay_hand_state.guobiao_opening_reset: reset preserves draw source only for the first acting player; all visual draw slots merge into the hand
replay_hand_state.shanghai_ordinary_draw: After a discard, d belongs to the next seat after that discarder. An intervening bh or bd retains its explicit seat.
replay_hand_state.hongque_added_kong: jg carries the first added tile, T/F draw flag, zero-based meld index and optional full list of added tiles. A missing index requires migration.
replay_hand_state.guangdong_doubles_blood_win: Keep the winning tile separate from the retired hand. Record multi-ron and the source seat (explicit, then added-kong owner, then last discarder); self draws have no source. After each win the next active seat follows that winner.

sichuan_duplicate_claim_clock.claim_seconds_remaining: Fractional seconds until soft expiry, independent of remaining_time and step_time. Repeating the same action_tick may only shorten the deadline.
sichuan_duplicate_claim_clock.waiting_draw: Keep the current claim actions selectable after soft expiry. Closing the window prevents a duplicate from reopening it.
sichuan_duplicate_claim_clock.is_tactical_recheck: Uses remaining_time with zero step time and a hard timeout.

paired_match.ready_wait: duplicate_match.waiting_for=comparison uses comparison_remaining_ms and disables readiness until both tables finish the board comparison.
paired_match.single_table_storage: Before opening a single-table V2 archive, om.single_round_meta.v1 restores omitted per-action defaults and identity legacy_node_map. Explicit round metadata is retained. Paired V2 archives keep their explicit table metadata.

sichuan_exchange_snapshot.receipt: The viewed seat can receive three sbr_received_tiles with sbr_exchange_direction and a positive exchange_receipt_seconds (default 0.75). Completed exchange snapshots close opening asks through their action_tick.
sichuan_exchange_snapshot.team_phase: xueliu_exchange carries outgoing_tiles, dice and cards_face_down for the corresponding stage. Animating or committed selections do not expose a new choice; a delayed copy of the original ask must not reopen it.

local_hint_transport.regional_input: local_request carries copied own hand, melds and scoring context; legacy precomputed replay rows remain readable
local_hint_transport.hongque_input: local_win_context carries tile, self_draw, before_first_discard and wall_empty; no precomputed hint result fields
local_hint_transport.changsha_exchange_six_input: private_state.local_hint_context carries copied own hand, melds, cuts and eligibility context; no private_state.hints
local_hint_transport.guobiao_input: wildcard and sixteen-tile clients use their local hand and rule context; no server hint result field is emitted
local_hint_transport.authority: win actions, settlement and bot decisions remain server-authoritative

joker_multi_wait.false: resolve joker identities before evaluating single-wait fans
joker_multi_wait.true: exclude single-wait fans when the completed hand contains jokers

scope_notes: 0.5.87 retains the common Guobiao hand-action and other-action allowlists. Session identity checks, settlement_sync revisions, settlement_restore replay and ready settlement_id are exercised by the dedicated settlement/session transport tests; this component simulator does not emulate the network dispatcher.

The single-table simulators consume player messages and replay ticks. Match subscription, independent table streams, migration, archive alignment and progressive scores are verified by server/records and the Unity MatchRecord validations.

Beijing and Duocai private state, choices and replay metadata, Hongque W scoring, and Sichuan duplicate wall masks, deferred settle_gang and kong-reveal presentation have additional rule-specific tests.
Localized settlement labels, replay queue clearing and animation suppression on reconnect are Unity presentation behavior, outside component simulation coverage.
opening_buhua_complete and has_draw_slot describe Unity presentation boundaries; the component simulator does not verify animation queues, merged draw-slot layout or elapsed presentation time.

Shangrao integration, unlimited-round UI, Android update prompts, spectator progress and settlement layout are outside the Guobiao component simulation; use their dedicated tests and Unity validation.
rule identifies the interactive lab session default; component and record regressions cover the listed additional profiles.
Dedicated opening selectors do not extend the common hand-action or other-action button allowlists.
Settlement label formatting is verified in Unity using the active replay rule context; component-state simulations do not render these labels.

Archive frame scheduling, paired table projection, optional record ranks and scores, the spectator list and regional settlement tile rows are covered by their storage, transport and Unity tests. The component simulator observes logical seat state and replay ticks.
Hashes detect source drift; passing the lock is not a claim that every field or visual behavior has been tested.

meld_display_signs.102: 暗面叠牌（备用）：位置及归属同 101，显示牌背；当前行牌规则不生成 101/102，展示牌不参与基础副露删牌或计分。
